message.content: An illustration for a magazine cover shows a central figure with their back turned, wearing a white robe, a turban, and holding a wooden staff. Several silhouetted arms and hands, some in white or blue sleeves, reach from both sides to pull on long, white fabric strips attached to the central figure’s clothing. The background features a gradient from dark blue at the top to a lighter teal, with rounded, low-lying landscape shapes. At the top, the white text "TEMPO" is prominently displayed below "LIPUTAN KHUSUS IDUL FITRI." Below the central figure, the bold black text reads "OBRAL GELAR HABIB," followed by smaller text: "Polisi membongkar jual-beli gelar habib. Muncul gerakan menyelisik keturunan Nabi Muhammad di Indonesia. H.22." At the bottom right, there is a barcode, a QR code, and text indicating the date "8-14 APRIL 2024," price "RP 50.000," and websites. The hands are depicted as dark, featureless shapes physically grasping and stretching the white cloth, creating multiple diagonal lines across the lower half of the composition.
